Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The heroes of Marvel Rivals continue to arrive!
In this patch, you will meet the Avatar of Khonshu and a beloved pop star.


New Uniforms have been added for Moon Knight, 
who protects the order and safety of the night as the Fist of Khonshu, 
and Luna Snow, who balances her life as a singer and a Super Hero.

 

Agents, please download the 4/28 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 

 

■ 4/28 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 4/29 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 4/28 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[4/29 (Wed) 2:35 (UTC+0), 4/28 (Tue) 19:35 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 4/29 (Wed) 2:32 (UTC+0), 4/28 (Tue) 19:32 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


Two new Uniforms, Luna Snow <Mirae 2099>, 
and Moon Knight <Blood Moon Knight> have been added.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 50% off during the <11-Year Anniversary Part 1 After 11 Incredible Years We Embark On a New Journey - Discount Events -> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Rivals.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Product Information

 

The World Boss Mission Upgrade Pack, available through the ‘World Boss Mission Event ON!’ event, has been upgraded.

 

- Event Period: 
4/28 (Tue) 15:00 - 5/19 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
4/28 (Tue) 8:00 - 5/19 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

- Sales Period: 
4/28 (Tue) 15:00 - 5/18 (Mon) 14:59 (UTC+0),
4/28 (Tue) 8:00 - 5/18 (Mon) 7:59 (PDT)

- Elite Gear Materials (Power of the Demiurge, Godstone) have been added to both Normal and Upgrade rewards and the quantity of Tier-4 and other Hero Growth materials has been increased.

- A new effect has been added to the 14-day buff list applied upon purchasing the Upgrade Pack.
New Buff: [World Boss] Elite Gear Material Acquisition +20%

- For more details, please check the event notice or the in-game interface.

 

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
